Every panel shows the fraction of rows with <math id="A4.F9.m15" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathrm{FRR}&lt;0.7" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>FRR</mi><mo>&lt;</mo><mn>0.7</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathrm{FRR}&lt;0.7</annotation></semantics></math>
resolved by depth and training step, where one row is one <math id="A4.F9.m16" class="ltx_Math" alttext="W_{qkv}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>W</mi><mrow><mi>q</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>k</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>v</mi></mrow></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">W_{qkv}</annotation></semantics></math> row
(<math id="A4.F9.m17" class="ltx_Math" alttext="D=d_{\mathrm{model}}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>D</mi><mo>=</mo><msub><mi>d</mi><mi>model</mi></msub></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">D=d_{\mathrm{model}}</annotation></semantics></math>); at these group sizes the membership-resample
pass rate at <math id="A4.F9.m18" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\theta{=}0.7" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>θ</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0.7</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\theta{=}0.7</annotation></semantics></math> is near zero, so the fraction is read as an
absolute population rather than as excess over a null. Panels (a) to (d)
share one colour scale and one colour bar, so the four sizes are directly
comparable; the pooled maximum is <math id="A4.F9.m19" class="ltx_Math" alttext="0.4323" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>0.4323</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">0.4323</annotation></semantics></math> (410M layer 21 at <math id="A4.F9.m20" class="ltx_Math" alttext="116" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>116</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">116</annotation></semantics></math>k).
Dashed vertical lines mark the row-level pocket onset, the earliest anchor
at which some layer stays above <math id="A4.F9.m21" class="ltx_Math" alttext="5\%" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mn>5</mn><mo>%</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">5\%</annotation></semantics></math> for three consecutive anchors of the
<math id="A4.F9.m22" class="ltx_Math" alttext="4" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>4</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">4</annotation></semantics></math>k scan grid: <math id="A4.F9.m23" class="ltx_Math" alttext="20" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>20</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">20</annotation></semantics></math>k at 70M and 160M, <math id="A4.F9.m24" class="ltx_Math" alttext="48" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>48</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">48</annotation></semantics></math>k at 410M, and none inside the
window at 1.4B, whose layer-15 population is still rising at the edge.
Rings mark the maximum over layer and anchor. Panel (e) shows the carrier
layer of each size on the same step axis with the <math id="A4.F9.m25" class="ltx_Math" alttext="5\%" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mn>5</mn><mo>%</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">5\%</annotation></semantics></math> criterion as a
reference line. The 1B series is excluded from this figure on the grounds
registered in Appendix <a href="#A6" title="Appendix F Pythia Scale Extensions ‣ Measuring Structured Predictability in Neural Training Dynamics: A Cross-Regime Study" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">F</span></a>, and its row-level
fraction stays at or below <math id="A4.F9.m26" class="ltx_Math" alttext="0.33\%" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mn>0.33</mn><mo>%</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">0.33\%</annotation></semantics></math> throughout in any case. All entries are
single-run readings on the public checkpoint series, registered as
descriptions of those runs; no ordering between the row-level onset and the
pool-coherence onset is asserted here.</figcaption>
</figure>
<div id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p2" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p2.1" class="ltx_p">At 410M the row-level population starts at <math id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p2.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="48" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>48</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">48</annotation></semantics></math>k while the pool-coherence
onset is at <math id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p2.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="92" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>92</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">92</annotation></semantics></math>k, so the row-level population is not gated by the
pool-level onset. The two are separable events and no ordering between
them is asserted beyond what each run’s readings show.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px2" class="ltx_paragraph">
<h5 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph">Layer relay within a run.</h5>

<div id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p1.1" class="ltx_p">At 70M the row-level population is a sequence of layer-localized waves
rather than a diffuse few percent: layer 5 rises first (<math id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="7.6\%" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mn>7.6</mn><mo>%</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">7.6\%</annotation></semantics></math> at <math id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="20" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>20</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">20</annotation></semantics></math>k,
peaking at <math id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="22.1\%" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mn>22.1</mn><mo>%</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">22.1\%</annotation></semantics></math> at <math id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p1.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="28" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>28</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">28</annotation></semantics></math>k, then decaying), layer 3 takes over from
<math id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p1.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="32" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>32</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">32</annotation></semantics></math>k with a double-humped trace (<math id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p1.m6" class="ltx_Math" alttext="13.2\%" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mn>13.2</mn><mo>%</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">13.2\%</annotation></semantics></math> at <math id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p1.m7" class="ltx_Math" alttext="56" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>56</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">56</annotation></semantics></math>k and <math id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p1.m8" class="ltx_Math" alttext="12.3\%" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mn>12.3</mn><mo>%</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">12.3\%</annotation></semantics></math> at
<math id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p1.m9" class="ltx_Math" alttext="76" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>76</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">76</annotation></semantics></math>k), the main layer-4 wave follows (peaking at <math id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p1.m10" class="ltx_Math" alttext="42.1\%" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mn>42.1</mn><mo>%</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">42.1\%</annotation></semantics></math> at <math id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p1.m11" class="ltx_Math" alttext="84" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>84</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">84</annotation></semantics></math>k and
staying elevated over <math id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p1.m12" class="ltx_Math" alttext="50" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>50</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">50</annotation></semantics></math> to <math id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p1.m13" class="ltx_Math" alttext="120" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>120</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">120</annotation></semantics></math>k), and a later wave arrives near
<math id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p1.m14" class="ltx_Math" alttext="115" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>115</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">115</annotation></semantics></math>k. At 160M the relay runs layer 8 (peak <math id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p1.m15" class="ltx_Math" alttext="32.8\%" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mn>32.8</mn><mo>%</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">32.8\%</annotation></semantics></math> at <math id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p1.m16" class="ltx_Math" alttext="92" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>92</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">92</annotation></semantics></math>k) into
layer 7, which reaches <math id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p1.m17" class="ltx_Math" alttext="30.3\%" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mn>30.3</mn><mo>%</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">30.3\%</annotation></semantics></math> at <math id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p1.m18" class="ltx_Math" alttext="116" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>116</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">116</annotation></semantics></math>k. At 410M the deep block, layers
18 to 21, rises together into a broad <math id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p1.m19" class="ltx_Math" alttext="110" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>110</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">110</annotation></semantics></math> to <math id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p1.m20" class="ltx_Math" alttext="120" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>120</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">120</annotation></semantics></math>k band with the
maximum at layer 21 (<math id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p1.m21" class="ltx_Math" alttext="43.2\%" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mn>43.2</mn><mo>%</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">43.2\%</annotation></semantics></math> at <math id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p1.m22" class="ltx_Math" alttext="116" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>116</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">116</annotation></semantics></math>k).</p>
</div>
</section>
<section id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px3" class="ltx_paragraph">
<h5 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph">The attention block moves together.</h5>

<div id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Figure <a href="#A4.F10" title="Figure 10 ‣ The attention block moves together. ‣ D.2 Emergence and Survival ‣ Appendix D Pocket Trajectories, Persistence, and Overlap Registrations ‣ Measuring Structured Predictability in Neural Training Dynamics: A Cross-Regime Study" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">10</span></a> places the three bulk segments on a common
scale. At head granularity the attention output projection shows no
pocket population at all (median FRR <math id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="0.993" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>0.993</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">0.993</annotation></semantics></math> to <math id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="0.9996" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>0.9996</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">0.9996</annotation></semantics></math> across sizes).
At row granularity it does: <math id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="19.3\%" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mn>19.3</mn><mo>%</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">19.3\%</annotation></semantics></math> at 70M layer 4 at <math id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p1.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="80" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>80</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">80</annotation></semantics></math>k against
<math id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p1.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="qkv" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>q</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>k</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>v</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">qkv</annotation></semantics></math>’s <math id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p1.m6" class="ltx_Math" alttext="42.1\%" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mn>42.1</mn><mo>%</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">42.1\%</annotation></semantics></math> at layer 4 at <math id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p1.m7" class="ltx_Math" alttext="84" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>84</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">84</annotation></semantics></math>k, and <math id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p1.m8" class="ltx_Math" alttext="15.7\%" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mn>15.7</mn><mo>%</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">15.7\%</annotation></semantics></math> at 160M layer 8 at
<math id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p1.m9" class="ltx_Math" alttext="104" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>104</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">104</annotation></semantics></math>k against <math id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p1.m10" class="ltx_Math" alttext="qkv" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>q</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>k</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>v</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">qkv</annotation></semantics></math>’s <math id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p1.m11" class="ltx_Math" alttext="32.8\%" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mn>32.8</mn><mo>%</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">32.8\%</annotation></semantics></math> at layer 8 at <math id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p1.m12" class="ltx_Math" alttext="92" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>92</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">92</annotation></semantics></math>k, about half the <math id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p1.m13" class="ltx_Math" alttext="qkv" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>q</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>k</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>v</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">qkv</annotation></semantics></math>
fraction in the same layer over the same period. The carrier layers of
the three segments agree closely within a size (<math id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p1.m14" class="ltx_Math" alttext="qkv" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>q</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>k</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>v</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">qkv</annotation></semantics></math>, attention output,
MLP: 70M 4/4/5; 160M 8/8/11), and their peak times separate only at 160M,
where <math id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p1.m15" class="ltx_Math" alttext="qkv" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>q</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>k</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>v</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">qkv</annotation></semantics></math> leads at <math id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p1.m16" class="ltx_Math" alttext="92" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>92</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">92</annotation></semantics></math>k and the other two follow at <math id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p1.m17" class="ltx_Math" alttext="104" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>104</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">104</annotation></semantics></math>k and
<math id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p1.m18" class="ltx_Math" alttext="108" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>108</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">108</annotation></semantics></math>k. We register this at the level of the attention block: the
population appears on the read-in and the write-out projection together,
not on <math id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p1.m19" class="ltx_Math" alttext="qkv" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>q</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>k</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>v</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">qkv</annotation></semantics></math> alone.</p>
</div>
<figure id="A4.F10" class="ltx_figure"><object type="image/svg+xml" data="2608.15483v1/app04_segment_pocket_overview.svg" id="A4.F10.g1" class="ltx_graphics ltx_centering ltx_img_landscape" style="aspect-ratio:698/374;" width="698" height="374"></object>
<figcaption class="ltx_caption ltx_centering"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_figure">Figure 10: </span>The same row-level population on three segments. (a) peak
fraction of rows with <math id="A4.F10.m10" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathrm{FRR}&lt;0.7" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>FRR</mi><mo>&lt;</mo><mn>0.7</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathrm{FRR}&lt;0.7</annotation></semantics></math>, maximized over layer and anchor,
for <math id="A4.F10.m11" class="ltx_Math" alttext="qkv" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>q</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>k</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>v</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">qkv</annotation></semantics></math>, the attention output projection, and the MLP output half at
four sizes, with the bar label giving the carrier layer; row scans of the

cells are drawn as explicit markers rather than as gaps. (b) and (c)
trajectories of the carrier layer of each segment at 70M and 160M. Two
conventions travel with the figure: the attention-output granularity is
less clean than <math id="A4.F10.m12" class="ltx_Math" alttext="qkv" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>q</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>k</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>v</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">qkv</annotation></semantics></math>’s, since groups are flattened on
<math id="A4.F10.m13" class="ltx_Math" alttext="(d_{\mathrm{model}},d_{\mathrm{head}})" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>d</mi><mi>model</mi></msub><mo>,</mo><msub><mi>d</mi><mi>head</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">(d_{\mathrm{model}},d_{\mathrm{head}})</annotation></semantics></math> with <math id="A4.F10.m14" class="ltx_Math" alttext="d_{\mathrm{head}}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>d</mi><mi>head</mi></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">d_{\mathrm{head}}</annotation></semantics></math> as the
unit and 70M reads <math id="A4.F10.m15" class="ltx_Math" alttext="19.3\%" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mn>19.3</mn><mo>%</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">19.3\%</annotation></semantics></math> at <math id="A4.F10.m16" class="ltx_Math" alttext="D{=}64" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>D</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>64</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">D{=}64</annotation></semantics></math> against <math id="A4.F10.m17" class="ltx_Math" alttext="13.1\%" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mn>13.1</mn><mo>%</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">13.1\%</annotation></semantics></math> at <math id="A4.F10.m18" class="ltx_Math" alttext="D{=}512" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>D</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>512</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">D{=}512</annotation></semantics></math>; and
group size differs between segments, so levels are compared within a
segment across sizes rather than across segments. The 1B series is
excluded on the grounds registered in
Appendix <a href="#A6" title="Appendix F Pythia Scale Extensions ‣ Measuring Structured Predictability in Neural Training Dynamics: A Cross-Regime Study" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">F</span></a>.</figcaption>
</figure>
</section>
<section id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px4" class="ltx_paragraph">
<h5 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph">The MLP asymmetry.</h5>

<div id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px4.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px4.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Re-cutting the MLP separates its two halves. Across all five sizes the
output half is the only cut carrying signal, with peaks from <math id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px4.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="1.8" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>1.8</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">1.8</annotation></semantics></math> to
<math id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px4.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="15.7\%" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mn>15.7</mn><mo>%</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">15.7\%</annotation></semantics></math>, while the input half and the magnitude cut stay at or below
<math id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px4.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="1.6\%" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mn>1.6</mn><mo>%</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">1.6\%</annotation></semantics></math> and <math id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px4.p1.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="0.12\%" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mn>0.12</mn><mo>%</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">0.12\%</annotation></semantics></math>. This is a third independent negative reading for
the magnitude hypothesis on the MLP
(Appendix <a href="#A2.SS6" title="B.6 Grouping Sensitivity and Within-Family Checks ‣ Appendix B Probe Conventions, Calibration, and Robustness ‣ Measuring Structured Predictability in Neural Training Dynamics: A Cross-Regime Study" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">B.6</span></a>). The carrier is the deepest layer in
every size without exception. The late waves occur only in the models
that have crossed their transition (<math id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px4.p1.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="6.9\%" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mn>6.9</mn><mo>%</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">6.9\%</annotation></semantics></math> at <math id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px4.p1.m6" class="ltx_Math" alttext="84" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>84</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">84</annotation></semantics></math>k for 70M, <math id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px4.p1.m7" class="ltx_Math" alttext="15.7\%" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mn>15.7</mn><mo>%</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">15.7\%</annotation></semantics></math> at
<math id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px4.p1.m8" class="ltx_Math" alttext="108" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>108</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">108</annotation></semantics></math>k for 160M, <math id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px4.p1.m9" class="ltx_Math" alttext="5.2\%" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mn>5.2</mn><mo>%</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">5.2\%</annotation></semantics></math> at <math id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px4.p1.m10" class="ltx_Math" alttext="116" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>116</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">116</annotation></semantics></math>k for 410M), whereas the 1B and 1.4B
maxima sit at <math id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px4.p1.m11" class="ltx_Math" alttext="8" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>8</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">8</annotation></semantics></math>k and <math id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px4.p1.m12" class="ltx_Math" alttext="12" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>12</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">12</annotation></semantics></math>k and are early-training residue.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px5" class="ltx_paragraph">
<h5 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph">Head-scale and row-scale do not coincide.</h5>

<div id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px5.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px5.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Within a layer, the head-granularity calibrated readout fades before the
row-level population appears. Measured with a symmetric <math id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px5.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\pm 32" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mo>±</mo><mn>32</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\pm 32</annotation></semantics></math>k window
around each layer’s pocket onset, so that the search is not restricted to
the pre-onset side, the median lag from the calibrated trough to
row-level onset is <math id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px5.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="+20" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mo>+</mo><mn>20</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">+20</annotation></semantics></math>k steps at 1.4B (four of four layers) and <math id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px5.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="+24" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mo>+</mo><mn>24</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">+24</annotation></semantics></math>k
at 410M (eight of eleven layers earlier, three reversed). The horizontal
counterpart runs the other way and must be reported alongside: across
cells the Spearman correlation between the row-level fraction and the
calibrated readout is <em id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px5.p1.1.1" class="ltx_emph ltx_font_italic">positive</em> (<math id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px5.p1.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="+0.10" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mo>+</mo><mn>0.10</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">+0.10</annotation></semantics></math> overall, <math id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px5.p1.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="+0.34" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mo>+</mo><mn>0.34</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">+0.34</annotation></semantics></math> late),
and the cells where the row-level population emerges have the same median
calibrated readout as the rest (<math id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px5.p1.m6" class="ltx_Math" alttext="0.208" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>0.208</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">0.208</annotation></semantics></math> against <math id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px5.p1.m7" class="ltx_Math" alttext="0.208" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>0.208</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">0.208</annotation></semantics></math>). A low
calibrated readout therefore does not imply a pocket. What is registered
here is a within-layer temporal ordering, not a horizontal association.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px6" class="ltx_paragraph">
<h5 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph">Form of the emerging population.</h5>

<div id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px6.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px6.p1.1" class="ltx_p">At 70M <math id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px6.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="qkv" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>q</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>k</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>v</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">qkv</annotation></semantics></math> the coordinates carrying the coherent motion rotate
continuously: adjacent-anchor membership Jaccard of the comoving family
is <math id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px6.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext=".14" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>.14</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">.14</annotation></semantics></math> to <math id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px6.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext=".18" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>.18</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">.18</annotation></semantics></math>, while cross-head timing sharing stays at <math id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px6.p1.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="0.75" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>0.75</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">0.75</annotation></semantics></math> to
<math id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px6.p1.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="0.99" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>0.99</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">0.99</annotation></semantics></math> throughout. Within a head the family condenses into two or three
row blocks, at four to eight times chance adjacency and <math id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px6.p1.m6" class="ltx_Math" alttext="20" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>20</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">20</annotation></semantics></math> times at
layer 5. In shallow and middle layers the per-head block directions are
private (cross-head direction cosine near chance at <math id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px6.p1.m7" class="ltx_Math" alttext=".035" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>.035</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">.035</annotation></semantics></math>) and only the
timing is shared; at layer 5 both are shared (cross-head cosine <math id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px6.p1.m8" class="ltx_Math" alttext=".82" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>.82</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">.82</annotation></semantics></math>,
effective rank <math id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px6.p1.m9" class="ltx_Math" alttext="1" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>1</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">1</annotation></semantics></math>). The granularity ladder settles the unit, since the
one-row and quarter-row distributions nearly coincide, so within the tested ladder the coherent object is row-scale. Pooled over all layers the
model-wide row-level fraction is stable across training (<math id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px6.p1.m10" class="ltx_Math" alttext="3.7\%" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mn>3.7</mn><mo>%</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">3.7\%</annotation></semantics></math>,
<math id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px6.p1.m11" class="ltx_Math" alttext="4.8\%" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mn>4.8</mn><mo>%</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">4.8\%</annotation></semantics></math>, <math id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px6.p1.m12" class="ltx_Math" alttext="4.4\%" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mn>4.4</mn><mo>%</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">4.4\%</annotation></semantics></math> at <math id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px6.p1.m13" class="ltx_Math" alttext="24" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>24</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">24</annotation></semantics></math>k, <math id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px6.p1.m14" class="ltx_Math" alttext="60" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>60</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">60</annotation></semantics></math>k, <math id="A4.SS2.SSS0.Px6.p1.m15" class="ltx_Math" alttext="120" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>120</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">120</annotation></semantics></math>k), so the layer-localized waves
ride on a small standing population rather than replacing it.</p>
</div>
</section>
</section>
<section id="A4.SS3" class="ltx_subsection">
<h3 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subsection"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_subsection">D.3 </span>The One Discontinuous Event</h3>

<section id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px1" class="ltx_paragraph">
<h5 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph">Where the <math id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="{\sim}20" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mphantom></mphantom><mo>∼</mo><mn>20</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">{\sim}20</annotation></semantics></math>k event sits.</h5>

<div id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Between anchors <math id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="19" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>19</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">19</annotation></semantics></math>k and <math id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="20" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>20</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">20</annotation></semantics></math>k at 70M the <math id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="qkv" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>q</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>k</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>v</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">qkv</annotation></semantics></math> pocket set collapses
from <math id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p1.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="51" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>51</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">51</annotation></semantics></math> groups to <math id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p1.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="3" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>3</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">3</annotation></semantics></math> and the layer-level median calibrated readout
drops from <math id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p1.m6" class="ltx_Math" alttext=".354" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>.354</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">.354</annotation></semantics></math> to <math id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p1.m7" class="ltx_Math" alttext=".000" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>.000</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">.000</annotation></semantics></math>, while the measured median FRR of the same
groups does not move at all (<math id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p1.m8" class="ltx_Math" alttext=".9959" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>.9959</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">.9959</annotation></semantics></math> to <math id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p1.m9" class="ltx_Math" alttext=".9952" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>.9952</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">.9952</annotation></semantics></math>, staying near <math id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p1.m10" class="ltx_Math" alttext=".995" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>.995</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">.995</annotation></semantics></math>
before and after). What moves is the null: the pooled
membership-resample <math id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p1.m11" class="ltx_Math" alttext="q_{05}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>q</mi><mn>05</mn></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">q_{05}</annotation></semantics></math> falls from <math id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p1.m12" class="ltx_Math" alttext=".9937" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>.9937</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">.9937</annotation></semantics></math> to <math id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p1.m13" class="ltx_Math" alttext=".7201" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>.7201</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">.7201</annotation></semantics></math> and stays at
<math id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p1.m14" class="ltx_Math" alttext=".59" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>.59</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">.59</annotation></semantics></math> to <math id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p1.m15" class="ltx_Math" alttext=".72" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>.72</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">.72</annotation></semantics></math> through <math id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p1.m16" class="ltx_Math" alttext="25" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>25</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">25</annotation></semantics></math>k (Figure <a href="#A4.F11" title="Figure 11 ‣ Where the ∼20k event sits. ‣ D.3 The One Discontinuous Event ‣ Appendix D Pocket Trajectories, Persistence, and Overlap Registrations ‣ Measuring Structured Predictability in Neural Training Dynamics: A Cross-Regime Study" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">11</span></a>). The
calibrated readout is a difference between a measurement and its null, so
this event is located on the null side of that difference. This is what
lies behind the caution in Section 4.3 that the fading of
head-aligned excess should not be read as a global disappearance of
predictable structure.</p>
</div>
<figure id="A4.F11" class="ltx_figure"><img src="2608.15483v1/app04_nullq05_companion.png" id="A4.F11.g1" class="ltx_graphics ltx_centering ltx_img_landscape" style="aspect-ratio:698/324;" width="698" height="324" alt="Refer to caption">
<figcaption class="ltx_caption ltx_centering"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_figure">Figure 11: </span>Where the <math id="A4.F11.m24" class="ltx_Math" alttext="{\sim}20" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mphantom></mphantom><mo>∼</mo><mn>20</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">{\sim}20</annotation></semantics></math>k <math id="A4.F11.m25" class="ltx_Math" alttext="qkv" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>q</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>k</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>v</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">qkv</annotation></semantics></math> event sits, in the measurement or in
its null. (a) and (c) layer-level calibrated readout for <math id="A4.F11.m26" class="ltx_Math" alttext="qkv" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>q</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>k</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>v</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">qkv</annotation></semantics></math>
(<math id="A4.F11.m27" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\tau{=}5" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>τ</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>5</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\tau{=}5</annotation></semantics></math>, raw) at 70M and 160M on a common scale. (b) and (d) the same
lane read as two curves: the measured median FRR of those layers (solid)
and the pooled membership-resample <math id="A4.F11.m28" class="ltx_Math" alttext="q_{05}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>q</mi><mn>05</mn></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">q_{05}</annotation></semantics></math> (dashed), with the FRR axis
inverted so that upward means lower FRR and the null pool merged across
layers per segment and group size. At 70M the pocket set collapses from
<math id="A4.F11.m29" class="ltx_Math" alttext="51" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>51</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">51</annotation></semantics></math> groups to <math id="A4.F11.m30" class="ltx_Math" alttext="3" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>3</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">3</annotation></semantics></math> between anchors <math id="A4.F11.m31" class="ltx_Math" alttext="19" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>19</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">19</annotation></semantics></math>k and <math id="A4.F11.m32" class="ltx_Math" alttext="20" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>20</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">20</annotation></semantics></math>k and the layer-level
median calibrated readout falls from <math id="A4.F11.m33" class="ltx_Math" alttext=".354" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>.354</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">.354</annotation></semantics></math> to <math id="A4.F11.m34" class="ltx_Math" alttext=".000" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>.000</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">.000</annotation></semantics></math>, while the measured
median FRR of the same groups is unchanged (<math id="A4.F11.m35" class="ltx_Math" alttext=".9959" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>.9959</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">.9959</annotation></semantics></math> to <math id="A4.F11.m36" class="ltx_Math" alttext=".9952" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>.9952</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">.9952</annotation></semantics></math>). What
moves is the null, whose <math id="A4.F11.m37" class="ltx_Math" alttext="q_{05}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>q</mi><mn>05</mn></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">q_{05}</annotation></semantics></math> falls from <math id="A4.F11.m38" class="ltx_Math" alttext=".9937" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>.9937</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">.9937</annotation></semantics></math> to <math id="A4.F11.m39" class="ltx_Math" alttext=".7201" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>.7201</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">.7201</annotation></semantics></math> and stays
at <math id="A4.F11.m40" class="ltx_Math" alttext=".59" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>.59</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">.59</annotation></semantics></math> to <math id="A4.F11.m41" class="ltx_Math" alttext=".72" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>.72</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">.72</annotation></semantics></math> through <math id="A4.F11.m42" class="ltx_Math" alttext="25" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>25</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">25</annotation></semantics></math>k. The calibrated readout is a difference
between a measurement and its null, so the event is located on the null
side of that difference and is not described here as a change in the
predictability of the groups. The 160M null line descends in two stages, a
moderate descent at <math id="A4.F11.m43" class="ltx_Math" alttext="13" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>13</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">13</annotation></semantics></math>k and a deep one over about <math id="A4.F11.m44" class="ltx_Math" alttext="72" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>72</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">72</annotation></semantics></math> to <math id="A4.F11.m45" class="ltx_Math" alttext="76" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>76</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">76</annotation></semantics></math>k, the
latter in the neighbourhood of that run’s smoothed loss minimum (<math id="A4.F11.m46" class="ltx_Math" alttext="77.3" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>77.3</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">77.3</annotation></semantics></math>k);
the time co-location with the loss landmark is registered as a
correspondence only.</figcaption>
</figure>
</section>
<section id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px2" class="ltx_paragraph">
<h5 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph">Composition of the null pool.</h5>

<div id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1" class="ltx_p">A single-anchor diagnostic at 70M at <math id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="25" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>25</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">25</annotation></semantics></math>k finds the null FRR
distribution long-tailed and bimodal (<math id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="q_{10}=.67" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>q</mi><mn>10</mn></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>.67</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">q_{10}=.67</annotation></semantics></math> with a jump to
<math id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="q_{25}=.992" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>q</mi><mn>25</mn></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>.992</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">q_{25}=.992</annotation></semantics></math>), and across resampled groups the FRR tracks the share of
squared update energy carried by the top <math id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="1\%" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>%</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">1\%</annotation></semantics></math> of coordinates at
<math id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="r=-.996" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>r</mi><mo>=</mo><mrow><mo>−</mo><mn>.996</mn></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">r=-.996</annotation></semantics></math>. The reading is that about <math id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.m6" class="ltx_Math" alttext="1\%" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>%</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">1\%</annotation></semantics></math> of large-magnitude coordinates
move coherently across heads and dominate the resampled groups.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px3" class="ltx_paragraph">
<h5 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph">Turnover across the event.</h5>

<div id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1" class="ltx_p">The set that survives is not a subset of the one that collapsed
(Figure <a href="#A4.F12" title="Figure 12 ‣ Turnover across the event. ‣ D.3 The One Discontinuous Event ‣ Appendix D Pocket Trajectories, Persistence, and Overlap Registrations ‣ Measuring Structured Predictability in Neural Training Dynamics: A Cross-Regime Study" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">12</span></a>). Jaccard against the final set is near
zero before <math id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="48" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>48</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">48</annotation></semantics></math>k (maximum <math id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext=".061" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>.061</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">.061</annotation></semantics></math>), rises to <math id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext=".5" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>.5</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">.5</annotation></semantics></math> to <math id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext=".8" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>.8</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">.8</annotation></semantics></math> over <math id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="52" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>52</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">52</annotation></semantics></math> to
<math id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.m6" class="ltx_Math" alttext="70" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>70</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">70</annotation></semantics></math>k, and settles at <math id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.m7" class="ltx_Math" alttext="1" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>1</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">1</annotation></semantics></math> in the tail, while the adjacent-anchor Jaccard
after the collapse has median <math id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.m8" class="ltx_Math" alttext=".88" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>.88</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">.88</annotation></semantics></math>: the surviving set is stable from
anchor to anchor but shares almost no membership with the pre-collapse
population. On the attention output projection the sets never stabilize
(adjacent-anchor median <math id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.m9" class="ltx_Math" alttext=".33" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>.33</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">.33</annotation></semantics></math>, versus-final median <math id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.m10" class="ltx_Math" alttext=".09" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>.09</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">.09</annotation></semantics></math>).</p>
</div>
<figure id="A4.F12" class="ltx_figure"><object type="image/svg+xml" data="2608.15483v1/app04_o3_pocket_turnover.svg" id="A4.F12.g1" class="ltx_graphics ltx_centering ltx_img_landscape" style="aspect-ratio:698/344;" width="698" height="344"></object>
<figcaption class="ltx_caption ltx_centering"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_figure">Figure 12: </span>Turnover of the pocket set itself, at group level, for the
one-pass 70M run (top row, dashed vertical at the <math id="A4.F12.m15" class="ltx_Math" alttext="19" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>19</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">19</annotation></semantics></math> to <math id="A4.F12.m16" class="ltx_Math" alttext="20" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>20</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">20</annotation></semantics></math>k anchor
pair) and the two multi-pass vision runs (bottom row). Columns: set size
on a log scale, Jaccard against the previous anchor, and Jaccard against
the final anchor. On <math id="A4.F12.m17" class="ltx_Math" alttext="qkv" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>q</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>k</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>v</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">qkv</annotation></semantics></math> the set collapses from <math id="A4.F12.m18" class="ltx_Math" alttext="51" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>51</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">51</annotation></semantics></math> groups to <math id="A4.F12.m19" class="ltx_Math" alttext="3" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>3</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">3</annotation></semantics></math> and
then holds <math id="A4.F12.m20" class="ltx_Math" alttext="2" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>2</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">2</annotation></semantics></math> to <math id="A4.F12.m21" class="ltx_Math" alttext="11" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>11</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">11</annotation></semantics></math> groups, with Jaccard against the final set at or
below <math id="A4.F12.m22" class="ltx_Math" alttext=".06" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>.06</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">.06</annotation></semantics></math> before <math id="A4.F12.m23" class="ltx_Math" alttext="48" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>48</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">48</annotation></semantics></math>k, rising to <math id="A4.F12.m24" class="ltx_Math" alttext=".5" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>.5</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">.5</annotation></semantics></math> to <math id="A4.F12.m25" class="ltx_Math" alttext=".8" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>.8</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">.8</annotation></semantics></math> over <math id="A4.F12.m26" class="ltx_Math" alttext="52" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>52</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">52</annotation></semantics></math> to <math id="A4.F12.m27" class="ltx_Math" alttext="70" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>70</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">70</annotation></semantics></math>k, while
the adjacent-anchor Jaccard after the collapse has median <math id="A4.F12.m28" class="ltx_Math" alttext=".88" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>.88</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">.88</annotation></semantics></math>. The
attention output projection never stabilizes. The multi-pass runs show no
event of this kind, with counts growing monotonically and the Jaccard
against the final set rising steadily, which is cumulative expansion
rather than replacement. This panel sets the reading conditions for the
two-anchor movement overlaps: because the pocket set changes both size and
membership between anchors, an anchor-to-anchor difference in overlap
contains both a change in overlap and turnover of the set, and the two are
separated only by reporting them side by side.</figcaption>
</figure>
</section>
<section id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px4" class="ltx_paragraph">
<h5 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph">A co-located depth reading.</h5>

<div id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px4.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px4.p1.1" class="ltx_p">An independent lane measures the effective rank of the <math id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px4.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="qkv" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>q</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>k</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>v</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">qkv</annotation></semantics></math> update
column space, as participation ratio divided by output dimension, in
phase-diagram windows. In the ballistic window both <math id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px4.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="qkv" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>q</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>k</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>v</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">qkv</annotation></semantics></math> and MLP read
<math id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px4.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="0.24" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>0.24</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">0.24</annotation></semantics></math> to <math id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px4.p1.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="0.44" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>0.44</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">0.44</annotation></semantics></math> at every depth. In the floor windows the MLP stays at
<math id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px4.p1.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="0.75" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>0.75</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">0.75</annotation></semantics></math> to <math id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px4.p1.m6" class="ltx_Math" alttext="0.77" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>0.77</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">0.77</annotation></semantics></math> (70M) and <math id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px4.p1.m7" class="ltx_Math" alttext="0.65" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>0.65</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">0.65</annotation></semantics></math> to <math id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px4.p1.m8" class="ltx_Math" alttext="0.85" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>0.85</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">0.85</annotation></semantics></math> (160M) and shallow <math id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px4.p1.m9" class="ltx_Math" alttext="qkv" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>q</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>k</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>v</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">qkv</annotation></semantics></math> at
<math id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px4.p1.m10" class="ltx_Math" alttext="0.59" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>0.59</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">0.59</annotation></semantics></math> to <math id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px4.p1.m11" class="ltx_Math" alttext="0.70" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>0.70</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">0.70</annotation></semantics></math>, while deep <math id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px4.p1.m12" class="ltx_Math" alttext="qkv" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>q</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>k</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>v</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">qkv</annotation></semantics></math> collapses, to <math id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px4.p1.m13" class="ltx_Math" alttext=".011" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>.011</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">.011</annotation></semantics></math> and <math id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px4.p1.m14" class="ltx_Math" alttext=".007" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>.007</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">.007</annotation></semantics></math> at 70M
layers 3 and 4 and to <math id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px4.p1.m15" class="ltx_Math" alttext=".007" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>.007</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">.007</annotation></semantics></math> to <math id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px4.p1.m16" class="ltx_Math" alttext=".030" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>.030</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">.030</annotation></semantics></math> at 160M layers 6 to 10. Those
depths overlap the layers that carry the persistent calibrated band after
the event. The two lanes read the same update sequence, so this is
registered as a co-located depth pattern between two readouts of one
record.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px5" class="ltx_paragraph">
<h5 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph">No multi-pass counterpart.</h5>

<div id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px5.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px5.p1.1" class="ltx_p">The vision runs show no event of this kind. Pocket counts grow
monotonically (ViT-mid patch <math id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px5.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="34" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>34</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">34</annotation></semantics></math> to <math id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px5.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="192" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>192</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">192</annotation></semantics></math>, ResNet <math id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px5.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="3{\times}3" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mn>3</mn><mo lspace="0.222em" rspace="0.222em">×</mo><mn>3</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">3{\times}3</annotation></semantics></math> <math id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px5.p1.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="280" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>280</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">280</annotation></semantics></math> to
<math id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px5.p1.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="903" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>903</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">903</annotation></semantics></math>) and the Jaccard against the final set rises steadily from about
<math id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px5.p1.m6" class="ltx_Math" alttext="0.2" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>0.2</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">0.2</annotation></semantics></math> to about <math id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px5.p1.m7" class="ltx_Math" alttext="0.8" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>0.8</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">0.8</annotation></semantics></math>, which is cumulative expansion rather than
replacement; the <math id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px5.p1.m8" class="ltx_Math" alttext="1{\times}1" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo lspace="0.222em" rspace="0.222em">×</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">1{\times}1</annotation></semantics></math> family is the exception, with a
versus-final median of <math id="A4.SS3.SSS0.Px5.p1.m9" class="ltx_Math" alttext=".12" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>.12</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">.12</annotation></semantics></math>.</p>
</div>
</section>
</section>
<section id="A4.SS4" class="ltx_subsection">
<h3 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subsection"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_subsection">D.4 </span>Overlap Registrations</h3>

<div id="A4.SS4.p1" class="ltx_para">

Every entry is a measured
overlap between pocket membership and an indicator that is not a probe of
the subspace-residual family.</p>

<math id="A4.T10.m131" class="ltx_Math" alttext="0.9\%" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mn>0.9</mn><mo>%</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">0.9\%</annotation></semantics></math>/<math id="A4.T10.m132" class="ltx_Math" alttext="6.1\%" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mn>6.1</mn><mo>%</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">6.1\%</annotation></semantics></math> at a<math id="A4.T10.m133" class="ltx_Math" alttext="40" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>40</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">40</annotation></semantics></math>) while the FRR share peaks at a<math id="A4.T10.m134" class="ltx_Math" alttext="10" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>10</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">10</annotation></semantics></math>–a<math id="A4.T10.m135" class="ltx_Math" alttext="20" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>20</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">20</annotation></semantics></math>

disentangled</span>
